verdict.rationale: Glama's pricing page claims a first-party automation capability: "Automate workflows using schedules or webhooks," which implies recurring or triggered background runs. That is the only mention, and it comes from a pricing bullet rather than feature documentation. Nothing shows how automations are configured, what they can do, or that they actually run unattended. Missing for 10: dedicated docs on setting up scheduled or triggered workflows, details of autonomous execution and monitoring, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Automate workflows using schedules or webhooks.
